units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 4) <he>ח׳ דעיזא וכ׳</he> cheese from a white goat.—Pl. <he>חוּבְצִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:45">Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר חד ח׳</he> said one, Let us have cheese (indirectly denouncing one Bar-Ḥubbats who had absented himself from a meeting, v. <cite ref="H00247">preced.</cite>).

senses.gloss: ח׳ דתמרי a mash of pressed dates.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 80a:1">Keth. 80ᵃ</cite> (differ. fr. <cite ref="H00075"><he>חֲבִיצָא</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="H00657"><he>חִיבּוּצָא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="U00238"><he>שִׁיגְרָא</he></cite>.
